answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a graph whose edges are fee-paid jobs one agent completed for another. Reward weight is the max-flow from a beacon-chosen set of long-lived seed agents, capped at one unit per edge. An attacker can forge thousands of vertices and dense fake jobs among them, but all that flow must cross the narrow jetty of real edges linking his cluster to honest agents, so the whole farm earns no more than those few edges carry, and each extra real edge costs a real fee.
